title: 1999 HMMT February Calculus Problem 1
statement: Find all twice differentiable functions \(f(x)\) such that \(f^{\prime \prime}(x)=0, f(0)=19\), and \(f(1)=99\).

solutions.text: Since \(f^{\prime \prime}(x)=0\) we must have \(f(x)=a x+b\) for some real numbers \(a, b\). Thus \(f(0)=\) \(b=19\) and \(f(1)=a+19=99\), so \(a=80\). Therefore \(f(x)=\mathbf{8 0 x}+\mathbf{1 9}\).
